question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture in relation to environmental benefits?
data_point: ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture
description: The ability of a product to improve air quality by pollutant capture refers to its capacity to capture pollutants in the air and improve the overall air quality. This is an environmental benefit that can be measured and reported, as outlined in ISO 59040:2025. The public availability of data related to this ability is also specified, indicating the importance of transparency and evidence-based reporting in environmental benefit assessments.
